name: NEAR Shoemaker
tagline: I wasn't designed to land… and yet I touched down on an asteroid.
discovery: During a year in orbit, I mapped asteroid Eros in detail: a rocky body covered with boulders and fine dust. I was the first spacecraft to orbit an asteroid, and then to land on one.
status_note: Silent since 28 February 2001. I rest on Eros, which keeps circling the Sun.

presentation.title: They told me: whatever you do, don't land. I'm NEAR Shoemaker.
presentation.body: I'm an orbiter from the NEAR mission. I wasn't designed to land… and yet I touched down on an asteroid.

chapters.title: A Valentine's Day rendezvous
chapters.body: On 14 February 2000, Valentine's Day, I enter orbit around Eros, a peanut-shaped asteroid about 34 km long. No one had ever orbited an asteroid before me.

chapters.title: A bonus landing
chapters.body: With my mission over, the team tries something incredible: landing me gently on Eros, even though I have no legs! On 12 February 2001, I touch the surface at about walking speed… and keep sending data from the surface for more than two weeks.

quiz.question: On what day did NEAR Shoemaker enter orbit around Eros?
quiz.explanation: 14 February 2000: a nod to Eros, the Greek god of love.

quiz.question: What made NEAR Shoemaker's landing so surprising?
quiz.explanation: It was an orbiter, with no legs or landing system. Yet it survived the touchdown.
